verdict.rationale: LanceDB documents a first-party plugin that lets a user drive it through an AI coding agent, building an ingestion pipeline from natural-language instructions. That is the product's own route to natural-language operation, but it goes through an external agent rather than a native natural-language command interface. The docs do not describe what the plugin can do. missing for 10: a native natural-language query or command interface, documentation of the plugin's scope across operations (search, table management, indexing), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Install the LanceDB plugin and use an AI coding agent to quickly build a multimodal ingestion pipeline.
Use LanceDB branches to isolate agent-driven experiments from main, evaluate them on a fixed test set, and promote only the winner.
